observations.label: before-submit-1
observations.sidebar:
- complementary:
  - button "Cleanup"
  - button "Collapse tool panel"
  - paragraph: Reduce colors
  - paragraph: Tighten the palette and optionally add controlled dithering.
  - group:
    - text: Images
    - button "Pick from gallery"
    - button "Paste from clipboard"
    - img
    - paragraph: Click to upload or drag and drop
    - paragraph: PNG, JPG, GIF up to 10MB
    - img "Preview"
    - paragraph: 64x32px
    - button "Remove"
    - paragraph: Upload multiple frames to quantize them to one shared palette
  - group:
    - text: Colors
    - combobox "Colors":
      - option "Auto detect"
      - option "Number of colors" [selected]
      - option "Palette"
  - group:
    - text: Number of colors
    - spinbutton "Number of colors": "2"
  - group:
    - text: Dithering
    - combobox "Dithering":
      - option "None" [selected]
      - option "2x2"
      - option "4x4"
      - option "8x8"
  - button "Generate · 0.1 generations"
  - text: Auto-add to
  - button "Off"
